entities.summary: The Satsuma–Chōshū Alliance , or Satchō Alliance  was a powerful military alliance between the southwestern feudal domains of Satsuma and Chōshū formed in 1866 to combine their efforts to restore Imperial rule and overthrow the Tokugawa shogunate of Japan.
